title: Stale-path over-promotion of unranked subnets
finding: Stale snapshot -> rank_subnets_by_snapshot returns None -> falls into _heuristic_hunt_pool -> unranked netuids (r >= _UNRANKED) admitted into capped set. Fresh snapshot -> unranked netuids assigned -1.0, sorted last, truncated. Two different admission rules keyed on snapshot age.
